Card Q&A.a: [Security] effects take precedence for activation. Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
Card Q&A.q: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

Effect: [On Play] By trashing 1 card with the [Reptile], [Dragonkin] or [LIBERATOR] trait from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, gain 1 memory.
